FLE-001.title: The Fleeca Job

overview.target: Fleeca Bank — Great Ocean Highway Branch
overview.objective: Infiltrate Fleeca's security network, obtain access codes, and execute a coordinated robbery.

FLE-001.intel: Lester Crest begins assembling a professional crew capable of executing high-value criminal operations across Los Santos. The Fleeca Job serves as the first major heist operation, testing the crew's ability to perform reconnaissance, bypass security, coordinate transportation, and manage law enforcement response.
FLE-001.dialogue: Ah ah. Yes, yes, this will er.. do very nicely. Very nice place you've got. Very er… chic. Nothing like a bourgeois bank robber to remind me of how strange Los Santos has become. In my day, the psychos at least had the dignity to be psychotic. Nowadays, it's all about home furnishings and going straight. Right. You ready? Because this is it! Well, it’s… It’s not it, but er… It's something, it's something er... very big. It’s not quite ready yet, but I wanted to see how you're doing. What I've got is a Fleeca Bank franchise. It's nothing too complicated, there's no buy-in. Now normally, there would be a buy-in, you would put in money up front, we would arrange the job, and you would pull it off, but this time I'll cover the upfront costs. Call it the er… price of getting a look at you. And there's no risk to you. Unless, of course, you count getting locked up or shot. So, you ready? What do you think? You er… got questions. Comments? Concerns? Alright, what are you waiting for? Let's go see this place.

planningLocation.observation: Apartment Connection: 4 Integrity Way, Apartment 30. Visible Landmark: Fleeca Bank flags. Possible Connection: the apartment view appears to reference the first heist target.

setup.name: 1. Scope Out Fleeca Bank
setup.objective: Before committing to the job, the crew stakes out the target branch to map its security setup from the outside — camera coverage, guard rotations, exactly where the vault sits relative to the main floor, and the fastest route out once the alarm goes up.
setup.locations: Fleeca Bank — Great Ocean Highway branch
setup.intel: Scouting confirms camera placement, guard numbers on duty, the vault's position inside the building, and which street offers the cleanest getaway from the first wave of responding police.
setup.dialogue:
There's a Fleeca franchise on the Western Highway near Chumash. Take us there.
Word of warning, we're on the job right now, so don't let the cops notice you. If they come after us, we call it off.
So, my taciturn friends, I suppose you want to know how we're doing this. Well, funny you should ask. We're driving out to the bank, taking a look at it, Picking up some equipment, and then heading back to make our plans. Not very complex at all. We're not going in, we're not poking it with a stick, we're just sitting back and taking a look. You see, I like my scores like I like my dates – across the street and unaware they’re being watched.
Alright, so why this bank, over all the other banks in the state, why does fortune favour this one? Another good question. You're full of good questions. You're like a child whose parents think it's clever, or the IRS. Well, this bank’s got some safety deposit boxes, and in one of those boxes are some bonds being hidden from the tax man, that no one's going to report missing. All starting to make sense?
Security should be like, well, relatively light, if your day dreams are raids on the Union Depository. Quite heavy, if your day job is turning over liquor stores and gas stations. And the bonds in the box will be worth more than a few rumpled notes from the till, so, the minor escalation is worth it... if you can handle it. Plus, you know, the seaview. Nothing like staring at the ocean while you contemplate money and power and incarceration, and homicide, you know all those weighty issues in your first foray into serious armed robbery. I'm assuming you're a kind of cerebral crew, because otherwise, this whole not talking to you just kind of put you on the spectrum, right? Okay, well, how about we just get there and see where we're at.
There it is. Take a look. Drink it in.
I've patched into the security feed on my cell. Take a look. What are we looking at? Small joint. Not much security. Staff won’t give a crap, especially about the deposit boxes. Customers will probably be thinking how to turn this into a screenplay. The boxes are in the back behind the safe door. We want box number 167. It's right on the highway with good access. That'll work for you, you can get out quick. But it'll also work for the cops, speeds up the response time. Okay? Okay.
Enough of this peeper crap. Let's go to the Garment Factory.
Now, when you hit the bank, you're going to need to hack into its security system. I've written a neat little program that'll do most of the work for you, but it's probably a good idea to familiarize yourselves with it. You in the passenger seat, I’ve sent it to your phone (BitterSweet). Take it for a dry run, keep your hands steady, and maybe the wet run won't be a disaster. I'm calling Paige. She's my assistant. First, she's going to get us what we need, and then she's going to saw me in half. Hahaha. No? Didn't like that one? Huh, you don't make it easy.

Lester:
Paige, it's Lester... Place looked good. Nothing we weren't expecting… Can you get the Intel together? Hard copies to go on a notice board... Yeah. Plus all the equipment we spoke about. I'll be over to collect it with those people... Yeah...Mmm, charming as ever...Okay, see you soon.
Hey passenger seat, get into their network? Good work.
She's loading the hardware into the back of a truck (Declasse Granger). Tools for the job, things for you to wear. On a job, your attire will depend on the role you're performing. As the jobs get more complicated, so will the uniforms. If you're likely to be seen by civilians, you'll be provided with a couple of masks, then, when you go into the bank, you can choose one that... goes with your eyes . And hey, there's the added bonus of none of your favourite comic convention outfits being linked to a major crime. Haha, whoop-dee-doo. Where were we? Masks! Paige! Oh yeah. We'll go over there, pick her up, and go back to your place to plan this thing. There's Paige. We're leaving this car, taking the truck. I should be using my cane.

Paige: 
Nice to meet you.

Lester:
Come on. Back to your place.

Lester: 
Is it all there?

Paige:
I think so... You wanna get out and check, go down the inventory? Or are you happy sitting there making a perfect butt imprint on your easy-wipe seat?

Lester:
I’ll take your word for it.

Paige:
Thank you. It should all be there. The clothes. Guns. Headsets, Masks, The Drill. The files with all the photos and surveillance work. Hey, there’s enough here to make us all look real suspicious. Nice little conspiracy to commit robbery charge waiting to happen.

Lester:
What, they gonna charge us with thought crime?

Paige:
Not so much thought as everything-but-the-deed-crime. We’d be caught with our pants down and a hard on out to here.

Lester:
Well, we’re not getting caught. These are professionals.

Paige:
So I hear. The cheapest professionals money can buy.

Lester:
I like to think of it as investing in new talent. She didn't mean anything by that, by the way. She’s just a little brusque.

Paige:
If they were offended, they would’ve said something.

setup.name: 2. Kuruma
setup.objective: With the target scouted, the crew needs a vehicle tough enough to survive a running gunfight with law enforcement during the getaway. An armored Kuruma fits — unremarkable enough not to draw attention beforehand, but built to shrug off small-arms fire once things go loud.
setup.locations: Acquired ahead of time and stored for the final job
setup.intel: The armored Kuruma becomes the crew's default getaway vehicle for the operation, prioritizing survivability over raw speed.
setup.dialogue:
Lester:
Okay, okay, okay. Now, Paige will set up a board for you, won't you Paige? 

Paige
But you’d do it if you could reach. I mean, I didn't see any milk crates for you to stand on. 

Lester:
The most important thing to look for in an employee is respect. You can’t get anything done without respect. Where was I oh, yes, yes, the room. Paige is setting up this board on which you will plan your scores. You'll use it to set out all the prep work you need to do, select your crew, figure out how to take from a score. How it should be split up. Need a crew to take a score, but only one person can be in charge. Respect. Isn’t that right, Paige?

Paige:
Blow me.

Lester:
Alright, you're only going to need one thing for this job, it's a high speed armored car. Instead of getting one legitimately leaving a nice long paper trail to your front door, you're going to be jacking one from a nasty Korean crew and leaving a nice long paper trail to their door instead. Good to go. Here's your board, good, good, good. When you're ready to move on the car, go over it, study the plan, tick it off the list. Even methodical, this isn't just a dumb crime. Well there there is an element of that, huh? And when you've got the car we'll come back here and talk, bank jobs, bank jobs, bank jobs.

Hello, can you hear me? I'll be here to talk you through all these jobs. Oh, what do we got here? Oh, yeah, the car. Okay. You're on the way to Del Perro. A Koreatown stick up crew’s been using a parking lot as a base for scores. Now, they're into extortion, credit fraud, stolen cars, and some mini major robberies. I'd expect them to be packing and I’d expect them to be paranoid. Come to think of it, you won’t find a billetproof car in the hands of anyone who doesn’t have a healthy dose of paranoia. You almost there? Remember, you can do this however you like, as long as you're careful. If you're not careful, they'll clock you, and then you won't get any choice how this is going down. They're meant to be on the top level of this garage on the north side, so I see two ways of doing it. You go up to north ramps and hit them hard and quick, or you go up the South ramp, get in position, and try to get the drop on them. From cover you can do whatever you like as long as you get it done. Oh yeah, we don't want anyone looking for you, so put on masks before saying hi. You got the car? Now drop any cops or gangsters or whoever you've got coming after you, and bring it to my garment factory. and try not to damage the car too much. You can't rob a bank in a wrecked car. how's the driving? I don't want to call this an idiot proof heist car. I mean there's no limit to some people's stupidity, but you gotta be very fucking dumb to let the cops catch you in one of these. it's got muscle, traction, lightweight armor that shouldn't compromise performance, this is the one for us. Now get it back in one piece and all shut up about it. How are you doing? Paige’s going to meet you under the bridge near the factory. This score is coming together.

Paige
Okay. I'll look after this. Lester will come by your place when you're ready to go.

finalOperation.dialogue:
Ah your ah your first time you know the first time it's never easy there won't exactly be a fireworks, you know? Be vaguely awkward and disappointing, you know? You probably stick the wrong thing in the wrong part and you'll finish too early, and... and.. you won't be able to make eye contact afterwards, but, but new worlds will.. will open up, something will have changed, you know? New opportunities, new risks, and that's when you'll remember that old Uncle Lester was here for you holding your hand guiding you through it, and you'll feel a little creeped out but you're going to repress it. wash it down. I never talk about it Okay, okay, okay. First time Fleeca. It's a two man score, right. One of you drives keeps the heat off of you. The other goes into the bank goes to the specific safety deposit box then you get out of there you get in that fast armored car and you get the hell out of that place, and once you're clean, once you got no heat on you, come see me, give me the box and get paid. I can tell you right now, you know what, like I said it is your first time so don't expect too much. There are wild insane mind blowing orgies in your future orgies. But uh, we all gotta start somewhere. Good luck

Okay, here we go. I'm excited for you. I've got goosebumps up my arms and butterflies in my stomach, and a light film of sweat on my upper lip. Do you know where you left the car? At least I hope you do. You weren't drunk on painkillers we’re you, no no that was me. Driller, I'm sending you that hacking program when you get in the car you need to get on it and start breaking into their system. You got the wheels? Alright, go to the bank. Driller start hacking their network, you need to establish a connection before you get to the bank, then you'll be able to trigger the vault door remotely the hacking programs cleaning up after you so you can take as many shots as you want and they won't know they're being attacked. Once you walk through those doors there's no turning back. Well actually there's no turning back right now, because I put a lot of work into this and I'll be really really annoyed with you if you don't go through with it. You know, I probably refuse to speak to you for a week and then spread nasty rumors behind your back and maybe set up a lifeinvader page about what a creep you are, you know. Be scary if I said I’d kill you wouldn't it? Happen at the age of the Internet when nothing is forgotten and humiliation is worse than death in a way. No, it’s not, is it? I should have made a death threat or like a mutilation threat. Said I’d, you know, here and cut off your nose or use your ass as an ashtray or do something with your tongue, not that you use your tongue. The next pair of mutes I try to help into a career of crime, I'll make sure I threaten. So since we’re actually doing this, I’m going to talk you through it one last time. We’re giving you pump action shotguns to take in, they should look intimidating enough. You go in, you go in hard. There are 4 security cameras in the foyer. Driver, take them out as soon as you walk in the door. Then you’re on crowd control. Driller, when you’re in the network you’ll be able to open the vault door on your phone. Go back to the safety deposit room and start drilling. You at the bank? You need to wait until the driller has got into their network before making a move. How’s the hack coming? You should have it done by now.

Okay, time to open the vault. Take out your phone and trigger the door. Here we go. Put on a mask if you haven't already and get inside. Take out the cameras, quick. You’ll be broadcasting live to the LSPD if you don’t shut them down. Okay, now, find that safety depository box. There it is. Drill it. Okay found the box? Okay, go in your bag and get out the drill. get and there it is drill it you don't have to wait you found the box OK go in your bag get out the drill. Okay, dont go to quick, it’s going to overheat. If you see smoke ease off. If the drill burns out, this whole thing will take to long. Keep going we need that box. How are you doing with that drill? That’s the box be ready to move. 

Go Go Go, you didn't come this far to end up in the back of a squad car. I’ve got my getaway guy waiting for you on Zancudo Bridge. He's got a plan for the cops if you can just get there. Guys name is Eddie Toh, he's a professional, he’ll take care of everything.

Eddie Toh:
Okay come in, This is your getaway guy Lester tells me you are inbound. Keep driving for the bridge, I got this under control. We have lift off. Let’s go. 

Lester:
Show it to me, yes it is the holiday season at the Crest residence and daddy’s out drinking. Say you passed. And if that thing I talked about comes up, I’ll call you. In the mean time if anyone comes to me, I’ll mention you as a reliable pair of hands. Hey, for a first time that wasn’t bad, but don’t get too clingy.

roles.duties: Positions the armored Kuruma outside the bank and holds it there under fire while the Driller works, then pilots the getaway once the vault's open — threading through the responding police without losing the vehicle or the haul.

Goes in on foot to breach the safety deposit boxes. Vault security resets after a set window, so it's a race against time as much as a drilling job — speed matters as much as getting through the door cleanly.

PRI-002.title: The Prison Break

overview.objective: Break Professor Maxim Rashkovsky out of Bolingbroke Penitentiary and get him out of the country.

PRI-002.intel: Agent 14 outlines the setup jobs needed before the breakout: securing an aircraft for Rashkovsky's escape flight, hijacking a prison transport bus, obtaining the inmate transfer schedule, retrieving Rashkovsky's car from a rival theft ring, and cleaning up loose ends connected to his case.
PRI-002.dialogue: Mr. Crest said we should talk about work but not here Is there a room in the back or something cool I'll get set so Mr Crest said you might be able to help me out with something Well not me so that's clear it's not me you're gonna be helping and I want to understood that I am not involved just a bystander doing a favor and this is not an offer of employment so much as an opportunity well anyway that's just getting a bit technical but the point is sometimes they're fair and legal justice system makes mistakes and this is one such time here he is professor Maxim Rashkovsky you know the professor used to be head of research for the Army Three doctorates overconfident polymath vain sociopath tedious egomaniac control freak geneticist weapons development engineer car nut but definitely not a people person accused of espionage along with everything else you don't remember well lucky you exceedingly vain and self absorbed man brilliant at everything he does yada yada yada makes you want to puke it's a **** **** traitor I mean he's a rat but he pays incarcerated for a crime he did commit but well let's just say money talks and he's going to walk so we got a few things to get ready all pretty straightforward do them one at a time but anyway you like standard op for gov fat breakouts you know what I mean. Alright first thing's a plane, then we get a bus and then well two things we get the inmate transfer schedule and Rashkovsky's car. More on that later. Let me show you we need a plane to get the professor out of the country. It's currently being used to traffic drugs by transnational street gang The Vagos. The Bus is a standard Bolingbrook transport vehicle; the least traffic is on the route from Paleto Bay, alright, that's where we'll be able to get a hold of one. You can get a hard copy of the inmate transit schedule at the LSPD  mission row station. Go in unarmed, play it cool you might not have a problem. That's a 2 person job max. The other two handlers are guys prized casco. We believe it's about to be shipped to Korea by a luxury car theft ring. Okay, Mr. Crest said you guys are at least semi competent, so well,l Professor Rashkovsky pays well.

setup.name: 1. Plane
setup.objective: Fight through Vagos gang members at McKenzie Airfield to steal a Velum aircraft for Rashkovsky's escape flight.
setup.dialogue:
So you're moving on the plane. It's at Mackenzie Airfield Logistics undecided. Do what I like but go in with a good supply of ammunition armor and maybe even explosives. It’s gonna get kind of heavy. Like I said before the airfield is under Vago's control they're using a plane to make the runs across the border, that means, it's already set up to take Rashovsky out of the country, limited radar, visibility, plausible cover story - it's perfect. Don’t let the fact  there are a bunch of angry drug dealers waiting for you affect how you go in. Or actually do.

Some more background on the Vagos. OK Globalized Multi national decentralized criminal network. Their principle interest is in drug trafficking but they've diversified into mid level distribution and juicer sales and trafficking other contraband. You get caught with a kilo of coke, they throw the book at you. You caught with a quart of Capybara seamen its a slap on the wrist. And the market for a large and endangered rodent ejaculate is lucrative. Most of the Vago’s upper management shot callers if you like are already incarcerated here in the States and throughout Central and Latin America they run their network on cell phones that's a relatively flat hierarchy at the top.  So if you cut one head off there's 6 more waiting to bite Not that I want to dismantle any criminal networks as you know I'm a criminal myself. I just like to do my homework The prison angle is gonna help us sell our raid on Bolingbroke. It's not something that they would do but it's the kind of thing the authorities believe that they would do which is all that really matters you get me.

 OK I’m leading you close to the airfield, remember once you engage these bastards.There's only one way this is going to make a plan then execute it no matter how good the plan is expect sustained resistance. Maintaining the integrity of the plane is the priority here. Don't rush this.

setup.name: 2. Bus
setup.objective: Intercept and steal a Bolingbroke prison transport bus during a police pursuit, then stash it at a Sandy Shores junkyard.
setup.locations: Blaine County convoy route, Sandy Shores junkyard
setup.dialogue: Take an old school bus, paint it, bar the windows and make it smell like blood bowels at your brother's high school. sorry we could do that but it costs money and this is costing Rashkovsky enough already so you're hitting the transport and you're not second guessing us again.  Set to move they're holding inmate class national security risk Bad news is that means there's non security detail the good news is the authorities will think we're trying to break him out and they'll be distracted from what's really going on you read me OK so we need the bus interact so this way to do that would be neutralizing the driver just so you know. Ok looks like things are heating up.  you'll need to lose the police attention before you come anywhere near us again. Hows the bus no ones hiding in the back with a cell phone a carton of cigarettes a pint of pruno up his ass. Amazing what they can fit up there. The lifers especially. You know those games you play where someone gets out a rocket launcher and people go, where was he keeping that? It’s so unrealistic. I say that you've clearly not spent much time in the US prison system. Levity and pop culture references are useful tools when trying to gain trust of new associates. Nice. We’ll hold on to this for you.

setup.name: 3. Station
setup.objective: Split into two teams — one poses as cops at Mission Row Police Station for the inmate transfer schedule, the other retrieves Rashkovsky's Lampadati Casco from a cargo ship at the port.
setup.locations: Mission Row Police Station, Port of Los Santos
setup.dialogue:
OK we got two teams split up and hit your objectives. I'm setting up a healthy atmosphere of competitiveness, use that. Station team you're going for the Bolingbrook Transit schedule. You got the right uniforms but they'll be no good to you if you turn up on foot or in civilian transportation. You got a car? Okay. Make sure no one is following you, You can’t turn up at the station when you’re wanted by the police, unless you’re turning yourself in, that is. Lose the cops.

From the looks of it you’re clear now go into the station and grab the hard copy on the way in you wont have a problem with the cops unless you act stupid. On the way out with the document, I don’t know. I would do this quickly if I were you just incase someone adds 2 and 2 and makes yeah.

Good work on the schedule but now you got to wait till the team on the car delivers it. Make yourselves useful or make yourself scarce. Okay.

Driver:

setup.name: 4. Wet Work
setup.objective: Split into two teams to tie off loose ends — take out Rashkovsky's business associate Dima Popov, and two lawyers outside the FIB building for their deposition documents.
setup.dialogue:
Hey, good work people, great job. We're still in business very well done all of you very very non incriminating yes that's the word I'm looking for. Now it's ironic given we ah, ah, maybe now it's not the best time to discuss irony. God what is wrong with me you know? I'm usually such a high achiever. Or a criminal. Popov

It’s not paranoia, it’s being prepared. Stupid. Maybe that’s why I’m not the asshole in the jail, huh? Yeah. Okay.

Team one took out the lawyers. If the guard see you and sounds the alarm Popov will run. And then he’ll disappear. And he won’t appear again anywhere where we could possibly get to him. Okay? So do it slow, do it quiet, do it right, and if you don’t, put him down quick when he starts running. Before it strikes a cheetah will spend hours crawling to its prey. The deposition has been secured. Get out of there now. All objectives complete. Good work everyone. Team 1 have made the drop. Documents secure.

finalOperation.dialogue:
Got a bit of a problem some asshole got wind of what we're up to. Apparently killing a guy's closest associate puts a bit of a spotlight on him. Anyway, now I'm told they put a price on the professor's head so we gotta move now is that clear? Can we get going, alright. I thought they were sending professionals, I collaborate and nearly get shiv for the pleasure. Just give me the gun. There are some screws I hope we run into. Let’s go. 

Asset acquired get to the pick up. The paycheque is in your hands Transporter, Protect Rashkovsky. Rashkovsky is not moving until we have some space here. He ain’t moving until the area is clear. Come on. You’re going out the way you came in, let’s go. We got a problem. Air traffic redflagged the plane and they’re scrambling jets. Pilot if they try to shut you down run evasive maneuvers. SER-004.title: Series A Funding

overview.target: Rival drug stashes across Los Santos and Blaine County
overview.objective: Steal drug stashes from rival gangs to sell for profit, then defend the haul at Trevor's warehouse.

SER-004.intel: Trevor runs five setup missions to gather product from various rival operations, then calls in the crew to defend the TPI Warehouse once every group he's stolen from figures out who's responsible.

setup.name: 1. Coke
setup.objective: Split into air and water teams to hit a yacht for a cocaine shipment.

setup.name: 2. Trash Truck
setup.objective: Collect drug-stashed trash bags from four locations around the city in teams of two.

setup.name: 3. Bikers
setup.objective: Raid a Lost MC stash.

setup.name: 4. Weed
setup.objective: Steal a weed shipment.

setup.name: 5. Steal Meth
setup.objective: Clear the O'Neil Brothers' farm, then escort a meth tanker off the property with two escort drivers.

roles.duties: Two players hold the north end, two hold the south, fending off waves of attackers at the TPI Warehouse.
Drive armed escort alongside the drug vans on the run to the drop-off, fending off pursuers.

PAC-005.title: The Pacific Standard Job

overview.target: Pacific Standard Public Deposit Bank — Downtown Vinewood
overview.objective: Rob the flagship branch of the Pacific Standard Bank and escape with the vault's contents.

PAC-005.intel: Lester's most ambitious job: five setups gather a disabling transponder, hacking equipment, thermal charges, and getaway bikes before the crew hits the bank itself.

setup.name: 1. Vans
setup.objective: Two teams (Driver + Navigator) use the Trackify app to locate and photograph Post OP vans, then steal the one Lester identifies.

setup.name: 2. Signal
setup.objective: Rescue signal expert Avi Schwartzman and deliver him to Paige so he can tune a transponder to disable the bank's dye packs.

setup.name: 3. Hack
setup.objective: Steal a hacking rig from a rival heist crew and swap it into your own van.

setup.name: 4. Convoy
setup.objective: Hijack a Merryweather convoy in Blaine County for thermal charges to breach the vault doors.

setup.name: 5. Bikes
setup.objective: Steal four Principe Lectro motorcycles from The Lost MC's East Los Santos clubhouse for the getaway.

roles.duties: Hacks the vault doors open.
Uses thermal charges to breach doors and security.
Two players hold the hostages and bank staff in the lobby.

DOOM-012.title: Act I — The Data Breaches

overview.target: Data on a series of breaches targeting sensitive government information
overview.objective: Investigate who's behind the breaches and feed the recovered data to Avon's AI, Clifford, for analysis.

DOOM-012.intel: Lester and tech billionaire Avon Hertz recruit the crew to track down a string of data breaches, framing it as a straightforward recovery job. Requires owning a Facility to unlock the planning room. Three prep missions (Paramedic Equipment, Deluxos, Akula) unlock three setup missions before the finale — this act is the gentlest introduction to the trilogy, but it's what puts the crew on Avon's radar for what's coming in Acts 2 and 3.

setup.name: 1. Dead Courier
setup.objective: A government courier has turned up dead with a data cache still on them. The crew poses as first responders — stealing an ambulance is the cleanest way to reach the body without drawing attention — then recovers the cache before anyone else gets to it.
setup.intel: The cache turns out to be only half the puzzle — it points toward a wider signal network still broadcasting data the crew hasn't accounted for.

setup.name: 2. Signal Intercepts
setup.objective: Using the amphibious, flight-capable Deluxos acquired in prep, the crew tails a set of moving targets — armored vans first, then boats — getting close enough to hack each one with the SecuroServ app before it can relay its data onward.
setup.locations: Across land and waterways in Los Santos
setup.intel: Each hacked target has to be destroyed immediately after the hack completes, and every vehicle carries an armed passenger, so it's equal parts stealth-hacking and running gunfight.

setup.name: 3. Server Farm
setup.objective: With the Akula stealth helicopter from prep, the crew flies undetected onto the roof of a NOOSE facility, then moves in on foot to quietly clear guards and cameras on the way to the server room.
setup.intel: Once inside, the job becomes a stealth puzzle — four servers need hacking while staying out of guard sightlines, since running or getting spotted blows the whole approach.

roles.duties: Fights into the IAA facility itself to physically stop the ongoing server hack before it completes.
Provides outside cover and mans the war room's gun camera system to clear remaining resistance while the infiltration team works.

DOOM-013.title: Act II — The Bogdan Problem

overview.target: Bogdan — a rogue foreign agent operating an armed submarine off the San Andreas coast
overview.contact: Lester Crest / Avon Hertz / Agent ULP
overview.objective: Work with Agent ULP to track down and neutralize Bogdan before he can destabilize the region.

DOOM-013.intel: Escalates hard from Act 1 — what looked like a data recovery job turns into tracking down a genuine rogue agent with a submarine off the coast. Five prep missions (Keycards, ULP Intel, Riot Control Van, Acquiring Strombergs, Acquiring Torpedo ECUs) build toward four setups that gather the intelligence and hardware needed to actually find and hit Bogdan's sub.

setup.name: 1. Avenger
setup.objective: Secure a Avenger jet, which becomes the crew's new mobile operations base for the rest of the act — replacing the Facility as the planning hub while at sea.
setup.intel: The Avenger's mobility is the whole point here — Bogdan's submarine moves, so the crew needs a base that can move with it.

setup.name: 2. Rescue ULP
setup.objective: Extract Agent ULP, the government asset who actually has intel on Bogdan's whereabouts and operations, before Bogdan's people can silence them.
setup.intel: ULP becomes the crew's inside source for the rest of Act 2 once safely extracted.

setup.name: 3. Salvage Hard Drives
setup.objective: Recover hard drives holding further detail on Bogdan's submarine and operation, filling in the gaps ULP's intel alone can't cover.

setup.name: 4. Submarine Recon
setup.objective: Scout Bogdan's submarine directly ahead of the finale, confirming its position, defenses, and the safest approach vector.
setup.locations: At sea, off the San Andreas coast
setup.intel: This is the last piece before the finale — everything from the previous three setups feeds into planning the actual assault.

roles.duties: Handles aerial support during the assault, keeping Bogdan's defenses occupied from above while the submarine team moves in.
Infiltrates the submarine directly to track down and neutralize Bogdan at the source.

DOOM-014.title: Act III — The Doomsday Scenario

overview.objective: Stop Avon Hertz and his AI Clifford from executing a plan to trigger a global cataclysm.

DOOM-014.intel: The trilogy's turn: Avon Hertz — the billionaire who framed Acts 1 and 2 as a hunt for someone else's conspiracy — is revealed as the actual architect, with his AI Clifford as the instrument. Six prep missions (Marked Cash, Recon, Chernobog, Flight Path, Test Site Intel, Onboard Computer) build toward five setups that arm the crew for a direct assault on Avon's fortified base.

setup.name: 1. Rescue Agent 14
setup.objective: Extract Agent 14, who has intel critical to understanding what Avon and Clifford are actually planning.

setup.name: 2. Escort ULP
setup.objective: Secure a Chernobog mobile anti-air platform and escort ULP safely clear of danger.

setup.name: 3. Barrage
setup.objective: Push back an assault against the crew's own operations, buying time to keep preparing for the base itself.

setup.name: 4. Khanjali
setup.objective: Steal a TM-02 Khanjali battle tank from Avon's own test site — heavy armor the crew will need for the assault to come.

setup.name: 5. Air Defenses
setup.objective: Take down anti-air defenses guarding Avon's base so the finale's air support isn't shot out of the sky before it arrives.
setup.locations: Pacific Allied Shipyard and surrounding area

roles.duties: Fights through Avon's fortified mountain base defenses on the ground, using the Khanjali and cleared air defenses from prep to push in.
Pursues and takes down Avon directly during the climactic final confrontation.

CAS-016.title: Casino Story Missions

overview.objective: Get up to speed on the newly opened casino and its ownership before the real operation — the Diamond Casino Heist — becomes available.

CAS-016.intel: A short run of introductory missions that come with the casino's opening. They establish the Cheng family's ownership of the building, put the crew on their payroll doing odd jobs around the resort, and — critically — introduce the Arcade property as the base needed to unlock and plan the Diamond Casino Heist itself. Nothing here is a heist in its own right; it's the on-ramp to Phase 10's real centerpiece.

CAS-017.title: Diamond Casino Heist

overview.target: The Diamond Casino & Resort's vault — contents rotate between cash, art, gold, or diamonds
overview.objective: Plan from a player-owned Arcade, then commit to one of three finale approaches — Silent & Sneaky, The Big Con, or Aggressive — to breach the vault and get out with the loot.

CAS-017.intel: This is the first heist built around genuine player choice in approach rather than one fixed finale. Two general preps are mandatory for every run regardless of approach — Vault Keycards (the only truly mandatory general prep, since it opens the mantrap between the casino floor and the vault) and Vault Contents (identifies what's actually in the vault this time: cash around $2.1M, art around $2.3M, gold around $2.5M, or diamonds upward of $3.2M). The same approach can't be picked twice in a row, so the crew has to alternate.

setup.name: 1. Casino Scoping
setup.objective: Photograph every access point and point of interest around the resort — staff lobby, waste disposal, roof terrace, helipad, and the security tunnel used by the Big Con route. Doesn't need to be redone every heist, but it's what unlocks entry-point choice on the prep board.
setup.intel: The photographed access points determine which entry routes are available when planning the finale — skipping a location later locks that door off entirely.

setup.name: 2. General Preps
setup.objective: A shared pool of prep work that applies no matter which finale approach gets picked later. Only one of these is actually mandatory — the rest are optional but make every approach easier.

operations.name: Vault Keycards
operations.objective: Acquire two keycards needed to access the mantrap between the casino floor and the vault itself. The only general prep that's mandatory on every single run, no matter which approach gets chosen.

operations.name: Guard Patrol Routes
operations.objective: Photograph the guards' staff roster at a Duggan security meeting to learn exactly where every guard will be positioned during the heist.
operations.intel: This intel shows up on the in-game minimap during the finale, making it far easier to avoid or time around patrols.

operations.name: Duggan Shipments
operations.objective: Destroy weapons and equipment shipments meant for the casino's Duggan-contracted security team. Ten targets exist around the map — the more that get destroyed, the weaker security is during the actual heist.

operations.name: Security Intel
operations.objective: Meet Vincent at Rockford Plaza after retrieving a stolen Gauntlet Hellfire, in exchange for a USB drive loaded with casino security information.

setup.name: 3. Vault Contents
setup.objective: Scout the vault itself to identify what's actually stored there this run — cash, art, gold, or diamonds — since the reward rotates and isn't known ahead of time. Mandatory on every run, same as Vault Keycards.
setup.intel: Diamonds pay out the highest but are also the rarest find; cash tends to come up most often.

setup.name: 4. Silent & Sneaky prep
setup.objective: Build out a stealth-first loadout — the least prep-heavy of the three approaches on paper, but the least forgiving once inside. Rewards patience: staying fully undetected buys extra time inside the vault, which usually means walking out with the highest-value loot.

operations.name: Support Crew Selection
operations.objective: Hire a Gunman, Driver, and Hacker for the finale. Their workload stays minimal if the run goes cleanly, but a bad Hacker in particular can cost real time.

operations.name: Acquiring the Hacking Device
operations.objective: Retrieve a piece of NOOSE or FIB tech that the crew's Hacker will need to work the vault door quietly during the finale.

operations.name: Nano Drone
operations.objective: Destroy five LSPD-deployed drones and collect their scraps, then bring them back to the Arcade so Lester can build a nano drone from the parts.
operations.intel: An Oppressor Mk II or Buzzard makes this much faster, since drone scraps can be picked up from the vehicle without dismounting.

operations.name: Vault Lasers
operations.objective: Steal two vault lasers from a location guarded by Merryweather and heavy army personnel.

operations.name: EMP Device
operations.objective: Steal an EMP device capable of cutting the casino's power for a short window, which knocks out security cameras and makes guards far less effective at spotting the crew.

operations.name: Infiltration Suits
operations.objective: Steal infiltration suits with built-in night vision — usually paired with the EMP Device, since the power cut plunges the casino into darkness.
operations.locations: Fort Zancudo or Humane Labs and Research

setup.name: 5. The Big Con prep
setup.objective: Build out a disguise-based infiltration — considered the fastest and most forgiving of the three approaches, since a good cover story keeps the crew from tripping alarms on the way in rather than needing to avoid or fight past security directly.

operations.name: Support Crew Selection
operations.objective: Hire a Gunman, Driver, and Hacker for the finale, same as any other approach.

operations.name: Gruppe Sechs Gear (Part 1 & 2)
operations.objective: Complete both parts of this job to unlock the Gruppe Sechs security disguise, one of two possible entry routes for this approach. Requires having scoped the security tunnel access point beforehand.

operations.name: Vault Drills
operations.objective: Acquire the drills needed to physically breach the vault door once inside, since the Big Con relies on drilling through rather than hacking or blowing it open.

operations.name: NOOSE Exit Disguise
operations.objective: Secure a second disguise, worn as N.O.O.S.E. personnel, to swap into partway through the escape and slip past the police response that's already converged on the casino.

setup.name: 6. Aggressive prep
setup.objective: Gather heavier weapons, armor, and a direct assault loadout — no disguises, no stealth, just enough firepower to fight straight to the vault. Fastest time-to-vault of the three approaches, but every shot fired damages a portion of the loot and draws a heavier police response, so it tends to pay out the least. Duggan Shipments, though technically a shared general prep, is close to mandatory here — finishing all ten shipments significantly weakens the guards' armor, aim, and health during the finale.

operations.name: Support Crew Selection
operations.objective: Hire a Gunman, Driver, and Hacker for the finale, same as any other approach.

operations.name: Vault Breach Method
operations.objective: Choose and acquire one method of forcing the vault door open by brute strength rather than stealth or disguise — Thermal Charges, Vault Explosives, or a Boring Machine, depending on preference.

roles.duties: Gets the crew inside via whichever entry point was scoped and chosen — Staff Lobby and Waste Disposal favor Big Con and Aggressive respectively, while Silent & Sneaky typically threads through the security tunnel or roof terrace to stay unseen.

Breaches the vault itself once inside — hacked open quietly for Silent & Sneaky, drilled through under a staff disguise for Big Con, or forced open under fire for Aggressive — then bags the loot before the timer runs out.
Hired ahead of the finale; their actual workload varies enormously by approach — nearly idle in a clean Silent & Sneaky run, essential for keeping the getaway alive in Aggressive.

CAY-019.title: Cayo Perico Heist
CAY-019.type: Kosatka-based heist, 1-4 players, first fully solo-capable heist

overview.target: Juan "El Rubio" Strickler's private island compound
overview.objective: Infiltrate El Rubio's island, steal a primary target plus optional secondary loot, and escape.

CAY-019.intel: The first GTA Online heist completable entirely solo. Planned from a player-owned Kosatka submarine. Gather Intel reveals the primary/secondary loot values and approach routes before prep begins.

planningLocation.observation: El Rubio's island has an extensive sonar network — approaching by submarine requires stealing a sonar jammer from a Merryweather sub first.

setup.name: Gather Intel
setup.objective: Reach the island's Communications Tower, hack the switchbox, and locate the primary target to reveal loot values and routes.

setup.name: Kosatka approach prep
setup.objective: Steal a sonar jammer from a Merryweather submarine to approach undetected by scuba gear.

setup.name: Alkonost / other approach preps
setup.objective: Optionally steal an RO-86 Alkonost or other approach vehicles (plane, boat) for alternate infiltration routes.

roles.duties: Enters the compound, reaches the underground vault, and steals the primary target plus any secondary loot.
Covers the infiltrator and helps carry additional loot before the escape.
